image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a lionfish (Pterois) against a dark background. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and prominent dorsal spines. The head is visible on the right side, showing a wide mouth and eye.
